project_name.justification: The text repeatedly refers to the project as SourceRock, for example: 'Metal Energy Acquires Highly Prospective SourceRock Project - Ontario's First Lithium Brine Project'.

company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the first sentence: 'Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV: MERG) (OTCQB: MEEEF) (the "Company" or "Metal Energy") is pleased to announce a new project acquisition ("SourceRock"...)'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company is named in a quote: 'said James Sykes, CEO of Metal Energy.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company is acquiring a full interest through two agreements: 'Metal Energy entered into an Option Agreement with an arms length vendor (the "Vendor") to acquire an undivided 100% interest in SourceRock.' and 'Metal Energy entered into a Purchase Agreement with an arms length vendor (the "Vendor") to acquire an undivided 100% interest in 9 mining claims (189 hectares) adjacent to SourceRock.'

primary_commodity.justification: The project's primary commodity is stated in the first paragraph: '...new project acquisition ("SourceRock" or the "Project") prospective for lithium ("Li") brines...'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Metal Energy Acquires Highly Prospective SourceRock Project - Ontario's First Lithium Brine Project', which directly pertains to the specified project of interest.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Metal Energy Corp., is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian stock exchange. Payments are denoted with '$', which is inferred to be Canadian Dollars (CAD) due to the company's primary listing.

cash_payments_raw.justification: This is the sum of two separate cash payments from two agreements. The first is a '$50,000 cash payment to the Vendor' and the second is '$10,000 in cash, payable upon closing the transaction'.

share_payments_raw.justification: A future share payment is part of the main option agreement: 'c) $500,000 worth of common shares on or before the first anniversary of the Effective Date.'

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Separate cash and share payment values were identified, so this field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: This is the sum of shares from two separate agreements. The first agreement includes '3,000,000 common shares of Metal Energy' and the second includes 'Issuance of 1,800,000 common shares of Metal Energy to the Vendor'.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: Calculated from the terms of the main option agreement: '1,500,000 warrants to the Vendor. Each warrant is exerciseable to acquire one common share of the Company at an exercise price of $0.10 per share.' (1,500,000 warrants * $0.10/share = $150,000).

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued (3,000,000 and 1,800,000), but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.02'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment specified in meters of drilling was found in the text.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The main option agreement includes a commitment for a staking program: 'committed to a staking program valued at greater than $100,000 representing 2,000 claim units registered under the Company.'

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The vendor retained a royalty on the main project area as part of the deal: 'The Vendor has retained a 3% net smelter returns royalty (the "Royalty") as part of the Option Agreement.' A separate 2% GVR was retained on an adjacent parcel.

coverage_area_raw.justification: A later article provides a consolidated project size after an additional acquisition: 'The Project is exceptionally large, covering 915 square kilometres (91,477 hectares)'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit is specified in the same sentence as the area measurement: 'The Project is exceptionally large, covering 915 square kilometres (91,477 hectares)'.

resource_size.justification: The text indicates that no resource has been defined, stating that historical drilling was not analyzed for the target commodity: 'lithium was not a marketable commodity when these drill holes were completed and thus never analyzed in either the fluids or the rocks.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are explicitly mentioned in the text: 'Metal Energy Corp. (TSXV: MERG)'.
